name: Signature
pose: He stands with weight shifted onto one leg, shoulders relaxed, a sharp, watchful gaze toward the camera — a coiled stance ready to move, his expression cold and calculating, a thin, predatory smile.
effects: A faint toxic-green mist curls low around his feet.

components.wearing: close-fitting Toxic Orchid Magenta-toned light leather armor, Tarnished Brass accent straps across the chest and hips, built for silent movement; faint venom-etched tattoos visible at the collarbone, a serpent-coil clasp at the shoulder
components.companion: his bonded Basilisk, a serpentine reptile with venom-slick scales and piercing eyes, coiled at his feet

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses the rogue-group default wardrobe set + the existing ossuary background (dark, toxic-fitting).
